# Math Basics Demonstration

## 1. The Quadratic Formula (Inline Math)

The quadratic formula $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$ solves any equation of the form $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$. The discriminant $b^2 - 4ac$ determines the nature of the roots: if positive, there are two real roots; if zero, exactly one real root; if negative, the roots are complex conjugates involving $i = \sqrt{-1}$.

## 2. Solving a System (Aligned Equations)

Consider this system of linear equations:

$$\begin{align}
x + y &= 5 \\
2x - y &= 1
\end{align}$$

Adding the equations eliminates $y$, giving $3x = 6$, so $x = 2$ and $y = 3$.

## 3. Matrices and Piecewise Functions

The $2 \times 2$ identity matrix and an absolute-value-like function:

$$I = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}, \quad
f(x) = \begin{cases}
x^2 & \text{if } x \geq 0 \\
-x & \text{if } x < 0
\end{cases}$$

## 4. Famous Equations

Three landmark results from physics and geometry:

$$E = mc^2$$

$$F = ma$$

$$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$$

## 5. Further Reading

See [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quadratic_formula) for more details on the quadratic formula, including its derivation by completing the square.

## 6. Money Context (Plain Text, Not Math)

The item costs $5 and the shipping is $10, for a total of $15. Budget: \$1000 (escaped dollar). These dollar amounts should display as ordinary currency, not trigger math rendering.
